I found five functions in `lib/` that call the response method `res.send`. I left out the two calls to the `send` package in `res.sendFile` and `res.sendfile`, as you asked.

- **`lib/response.js`**
  - `res.json` calls `this.send(body)` (line 279).
  - `res.jsonp` calls `this.send(body)` (line 352).
  - `res.sendStatus` calls `this.send(body)` (line 376).
  - `res.render` calls `self.send(str)` (line 1044) inside its default `done` callback. That callback is a closure, so the call is credited to `render`.
- **`lib/router/index.js`**
  - `sendOptionsResponse` calls `res.send(body)` (line 655).

`res.redirect` and `res.format` don't call `send`; `redirect` uses `this.end`.
